process.header: How Does Your Treatment Process Work?
process.desc: We're by your side at every step, from the first consultation to treatment.

process.desc1: We take a detailed medical history, perform a physical assessment, and set treatment goals together. Duration: 45-60 minutes.
process.desc2: Based on the assessment results, a treatment plan tailored to you is prepared. You'll be informed about goals, duration, and methods.
process.desc3: Sessions take place 2-3 times a week, averaging 30-45 minutes. Progress is evaluated and the plan updated at every session.
process.desc4: Home exercise programs are provided throughout treatment. Afterwards, you're supported with care programs to protect your health.

faqList.q: How long do treatment sessions last?
faqList.a: The initial assessment session lasts 45-60 minutes. Treatment sessions generally range between 30-45 minutes. The session duration is adjusted according to the type of treatment and your needs.

faqList.q: Is any pain felt during treatment?
faqList.a: Physiotherapy sessions can be uncomfortable but generally don't cause distressing pain. Your physiotherapist always works within your comfort limits. Mild tenderness after a session is normal.

faqList.q: Is an appointment required for a session?
faqList.a: Yes, an appointment is required for all treatment sessions. You can easily book through our online appointment system or by calling us. For your first visit, please schedule at least 24 hours in advance.

faqList.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqList.a: We accept cash, credit card, and debit card payments. We also have partner agreements with private health insurance providers. Please get in touch with us for detailed information.

faqList.q: How many treatment sessions will I need?
faqList.a: The number of sessions varies depending on your condition and response to treatment. Generally, 6-10 sessions are recommended for acute cases and 12-20 for chronic ones. A precise number is determined after the initial assessment, with regular progress evaluations.

hero.header2: By Your Side Every Step of the Way.
hero.desc: With over 12 years of experience, our one-on-one treatment philosophy, and our patient satisfaction-focused approach, we make a difference in the field of physiotherapy.
hero.sub-header: Our Goal: Lasting Solutions, Lasting Health.
hero.sub-desc1: FizyoVital was founded in Istanbul in 2013. At the heart of our founding lies the belief that every individual deserves access to quality physiotherapy care. To this day, we have helped thousands of patients regain their health — and we continue to do so.
hero.sub-desc2: Our goal is not merely to relieve pain, but to identify its root causes and help our patients return to their daily lives independently. Every patient is unique to us; we serve this goal through personalized treatment plans, evidence-based methods, and our continuously growing team of experts.

our-values.desc: These values guide us throughout every treatment process.

value1.desc: All of our treatment methods are based on international scientific research and evidence-based protocols. By keeping up with current literature, we deliver the most effective treatment available.

value2.desc: Each of our patients has different needs, goals, and lifestyles. That is precisely why we create personalized treatment plans and manage the process together.

value3.desc: Our team continually grows through regular training, certifications, and conference participation. We integrate the latest techniques and technologies into our treatment processes.

value4.desc: We always maintain open and honest communication with our patients about treatment processes, expectations, and progress. Trust is the foundation of health.

our-approaches.desc: What sets us apart and our treatment philosophy.

approach1.desc: Every treatment begins with a detailed medical history, physical examination, and functional assessment. Without rushing, we build your treatment plan by seeing the complete picture.

approach2.desc: Based on the assessment results, we determine the most suitable treatment method, session frequency, and duration together with you. Your goals are our goals.

approach3.desc: Your progress is regularly evaluated throughout the sessions. Your treatment plan is updated according to your response — we move forward with a dynamic process, not a static plan.

approach4.desc: After treatment, you are supported with exercise programs and recommendations to protect your health. Our goal is to ensure you never experience the same problem again.
